title: Testing of Your Faith, Hearing and Doing the Word

questions.question: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes in the ____: Greetings.
questions.explanation: James 1:1 (ESV): "James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, To the twelve tribes in the Dispersion: Greetings."

questions.question: Count it all ____, my brothers, when you meet trials of various kinds,
questions.explanation: James 1:2 (ESV): "Count it all joy, my brothers, when you meet trials of various kinds,"

questions.question: for you know that the testing of your faith produces ____.
questions.explanation: James 1:3 (ESV): "for you know that the testing of your faith produces steadfastness."

questions.question: And let steadfastness have its full effect, that you may be perfect and ____, lacking in nothing.
questions.explanation: James 1:4 (ESV): "And let steadfastness have its full effect, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing."

questions.question: If any of you lacks ____, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach, and it will be given him.
questions.explanation: James 1:5 (ESV): "If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach, and it will be given him."

questions.question: But let him ask in faith, with no ____, for the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea that is driven and tossed by the wind.
questions.explanation: James 1:6 (ESV): "But let him ask in faith, with no doubting, for the one who doubts is like a wave of the sea that is driven and tossed by the wind."

questions.question: For that person must not suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord; he is a ____-minded man, unstable in all his ways.
questions.explanation: James 1:7-8 (ESV): "For that person must not suppose that he will receive anything from the Lord; he is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways."

questions.question: Let the lowly brother boast in his exaltation, and the ____ in his humiliation, because like a flower of the grass he will pass away.
questions.explanation: James 1:9-10 (ESV): "Let the lowly brother boast in his exaltation, and the rich in his humiliation, because like a flower of the grass he will pass away."

questions.question: Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test he will receive the crown of ____,
questions.explanation: James 1:12 (ESV): "Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him."

questions.question: Let no one say when he is tempted, "I am being tempted by ____," for God cannot be tempted with evil, and he himself tempts no one.
questions.explanation: James 1:13 (ESV): "Let no one say when he is tempted, 'I am being tempted by God,' for God cannot be tempted with evil, and he himself tempts no one."

questions.question: But each person is tempted when he is lured and enticed by his own ____.
questions.explanation: James 1:14 (ESV): "But each person is tempted when he is lured and enticed by his own desire."

questions.question: Then ____ when it has conceived gives birth to sin, and sin when it is fully grown brings forth ____.
questions.explanation: James 1:15 (ESV): "Then desire when it has conceived gives birth to sin, and sin when it is fully grown brings forth death."

questions.question: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of ____, with whom there is no variation or shadow due to change.
questions.explanation: James 1:17 (ESV): "Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom there is no variation or shadow due to change."

questions.question: Know this, my beloved brothers: let every person be quick to hear, slow to ____, slow to anger;
questions.explanation: James 1:19 (ESV): "Know this, my beloved brothers: let every person be quick to hear, slow to speak, slow to anger;"

questions.question: But be ____ of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
questions.explanation: James 1:22 (ESV): "But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves."

key_verse_text: But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.
